import hashlib,json,os,stat,subprocess,time

base=Path('target/wp899')

assert d['state']=='ROOT_RECONCILED_FROZEN_READY_FOR_ONE_ASSOCIATION_OBSERVATION'
assert d['global_actual_attempt']==6 and d['new_contract_attempt']==1 and d['attempt_budget']==1 and not d['automatic_retries']
assert hashlib.sha256((base/'genuine-root-association-invocation-draft.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()==d['reviewed_draft_sha256']
assert len(d['independent_final_reviews'])==3
for table in ['source_hashes','prerequisite_hashes','independent_final_reviews']:
    for name,pin in d[table].items():assert hashlib.sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==pin,name
for name,pin in d['prior_spent_evidence'].items():assert hashlib.sha256((base/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==pin,name
for key in ['python','artifact']:assert hashlib.sha256(Path(d[key]['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==d[key]['sha256']
for item in json.loads((base/'genuine-harness-input-pins.json').read_text())['inputs']:
    content=Path(item['path']).read_bytes();assert len(content)==item['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()==item['sha256']
p=Path(d['stage_parent']['path']);fd=os.open(p,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC)
try:
    i=os.fstat(fd);want=d['stage_parent']
    assert (i.st_dev,i.st_ino,i.st_uid,oct(stat.S_IMODE(i.st_mode)))==(want['device'],want['inode'],want['uid'],want['mode'])
    assert not os.listdir(fd)
finally:os.close(fd)
for name in d['output_paths_absent']:
    if name!=str(freeze.resolve()):assert not os.path.lexists(name),name
assert not subprocess.run(['git','status','--porcelain'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
assert subprocess.run(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()==d['base']
assert subprocess.run(['ps','-C','cargo','-C','rustc','-C','slug','-C','slugd','-o','pid=,comm='],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip()==''

r={'schema':1,'freeze_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'global_actual_attempt':6,'new_contract_attempt':1,'state':'CLAIMED_NO_RETRY','command':d['command'],'prelaunch_source_prereq_review_spent_artifact_python_input6_parent_outputs_clean_no_overlap_verified':True}

start=time.monotonic()
run=subprocess.run(d['command'],cwd=d['cwd'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
r.update({'state':'TERMINAL_NO_RETRY','wrapper_exit_code':run.returncode,'wrapper_elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'supervisor_stdout_bytes':len(run.stdout),'supervisor_stderr_bytes':len(run.stderr)})
